standard_prerequisites: the arrow property rig-etale for continuous homomorphisms of Noetherian adic rings and its meaning (lemma-rig-etale-continuous of the same chapter)
the composition property of Formal Spaces, Remark formal-spaces-remark-composition-variant-Noetherian

the rig-etale criterion in terms of annihilation of the cohomology of NL^wedge by powers of an ideal of definition (lemma-equivalent-with-artin of the same chapter)
core_obligations: Prove that the property P(varphi) = 'varphi is rig-etale' on arrows of WAdm^Noeth is stable under composition: if A -> B and B -> C are rig-etale, then A -> C is rig-etale
proof_roadmap: Choose an ideal of definition I of A inducing the topologies on B and C, and write the exact six-term sequence relating the cohomology of NL^wedge_{B/A} tensor C, NL^wedge_{C/A} and NL^wedge_{C/B}.

Rig-etale hypotheses give c >= 0 with a^c killing NL^wedge_{B/A} in D(B) and NL^wedge_{C/B} in D(C) for all a in I; tensoring keeps the vanishing, so the four outer terms of the sequence are annihilated by a^c.
The exact sequence then shows a^{2c} kills H^0 and H^{-1} of NL^wedge_{C/A}, and the equivalence lemma of the chapter concludes that C is rig-etale over (A, I).
difficulty_reason: H3: a homological-algebra chase through the cotangent exact sequence converting two annihilation statements into one for the composite.
